[1112 ] LOOK
NAME
look - look in a direction, or at or in an object, or at a creature

SYNOPSIS
 look
 look <direction>
 look <creature or player name>
 look <object name or type>
 look #.<object name or type>
 look in <container object name or type>

 look _lore_selection_info <item> - display general item information
 look _lore_selection_relics <item> - display bound relics
 look _lore_selection_v_values <item> - show item type-specific context
 look _lore_selection_requirements <item> - list requirements
 look _lore_selection_objset <item> - see information about the object set
 look _lore_selection_description <item> - see only the lore description
 look _lore_selection_affects <item> - list only affects
 look _lore_selection_lifespan <item> - see just lifespan information
 look _lore_selection_plusplusplus <item> - see just the script description

DESCRIPTION
 This is a very useful informational command that tells you about the room
or area that you are currently in.  You can also look at other characters,
look at objects, look inside objects, and look in a specific direction to
see what's in the adjoining area.  

You can also reference NPCs and items using quotes around the full short
description instead of just name keywords.  For example, if the item is
called "a wizard's cloak", you can reference it by typing: look "a wizard's
cloak".  For an NPC named "a dashing acrobat", you could reference him by
typing: look "a dashing acrobat".  

If you see an asterisk (*) or a single letter in brackets [S] before a PC or
NPC's brief description when using LOOK in a room, it means they have a
special affect on them:

* A dark red asterisk or [L] indicates they are surrounded by a lava
cloak, and are resilient, taking reduced damage.  

* A magenta asterisk or [R] indicates they are surrounded by a repulsion
field, and will be difficult to kill with thrown or ranged damage.  

* A cyan asterisk or [P] indicates they will paralyze in combat.  

* A cyan asterisk or [T] indicates they are translucent, affected by a
'pass door' spell.  

* A green asterisk or [I] indicates they are invisible to others who
cannot detect invisibility (which you obviously can, or you would not see
them).  

* A white asterisk or [S] indicates they are surrounded by a glowing
white aura, a side effect of the 'sanctuary' spell.  

* A red asterisk or [F] indicates they are surrounded by a shield of
flames, caused by the 'fireshield' spell.  

* A blue asterisk or [L] indicates they are surrounded by an electrical
shield, most likely from the 'lightning shroud' spell.  

When there are multiple items or NPCs of the same name in the same location,
whether in your inventory or in your room, you may reference them
individually by putting the number of the item or NPC and a period before
the name.  (Look <#>.name) For example:

look 5.balrog

 [1533] sanctuary - defeat evil with improved damage and healing

You take note of the directions on a weatherbeaten signpost at the site of the Old Bazaar, and head northwest.
You travel northwestward on a restless horse.
